title: Reject synchronous parallel counted Balanced digest
question: Can native counted singleton Balanced reduce digest elapsed through the existing worker pool?
summary: The four-worker synchronous BLAKE3 pool handoff and wider digest buffer increased median complete elapsed by 30.41% and process CPU by 119.90% at 2 GiB. Removed the prototype after all three pairs favored serial.

workloads: 2 GiB UTF-8 CSV to eight exact Balanced parts, 300 MiB serialized cap, four workers, engine m256, hard 1 GiB with no swap.

validation.summary: Three matched complete pairs passed independent full verification of fields, order, quotas, caps, logical digest equality and cleanup.

limitations: One synthetic repeated workload in WSL2/ext4.
The implementation bundles a larger buffer and synchronous pool dispatch.
Parent cgroup peaks include file cache.
exclusions: Small preflight, full-size warmup and one-worker perf profile.
reopen_when: Only revisit with a distinct scheduling or data movement mechanism that removes a measured cost. Do not tune the rejected synchronous pool handoff.
